title: Fold executor-reported Windows separators to POSIX canonical artifact names
description: BASE 02c5944 (merged staging/pr59-safe tip). Lands the artifact-ingress separator normalization that existed on the audited source-terms ancestry but was never merged upstream. src/pair/artifact-validation.ts: ArtifactProvenanceValidator now folds backslashes to '/' on the executor-reported path before canonical-name checks — a Windows executor reporting outbox\report.txt mints the same POSIX logical name outbox/report.txt instead of a divergent spelling. Security consequence: '..\escape.txt' traversal is folded to '../escape.txt' and now rejected by the '..' segment check (previously bypassed since the check only split on '/'). Absolute and '..' forms stay rejected on the normalized spelling. Tests: pair-f1-artifact-authority.test.ts adds A1b (backslash path validates PASS, canonical logical_name correct, sha256 bound) and A1c (backslash traversal FAIL, zero artifact rows). scripts/dev-verification/lib.mjs adds the win32 tolerated-baseline for pair-f2-r4-remediation (8 fails, unix-only spawn semantics exit 127, measured BASE==HEAD). No architecture change, no planner/router/dataflow touch.
